name: @pipeworx/mcp-powo

tools.name: search_plants
tools.description: Search POWO (Plants of the World Online, by Kew) — the authoritative global plant taxonomy database — for accepted plant names and synonyms by scientific or common name. Returns matching taxa with their family, rank, whether the name is accepted, and a POWO fqId you can pass to get_taxon. Keyless. Complements GBIF/iNaturalist with curated botanical taxonomy.

query.description: Scientific or common plant name, e.g. "Quercus robur" or "English oak".

tools.name: get_taxon
tools.description: Fetch a full POWO (Plants of the World Online, by Kew) taxon record by its fqId (e.g. "urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:304293-2", obtained from search_plants). Returns the taxon's classification, family/genus, taxonomic status, native distribution (TDWG region codes), accepted-name resolution (for synonyms), and synonym count. Keyless authoritative botanical taxonomy.

fq_id.description: A POWO fqId like "urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:304293-2" (from search_plants results).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-powo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the powo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
